text:
Jamie: hi all — i'm Jamie, started today in infra eng. quick access question: can someone grant me Datadog, Grafana view-only, and Sentry dev-team access? trying to onboard to observability for my first-week tasks. ty!

Alex: welcome Jamie :tada: — cc @it-ops for provisioning. can you confirm your email (company) and which teams (e.g., infra, platform)?

Jamie: thanks! email jamie@redwood.com. teams: infra and eng-sre. would also like dashboard links if possible (errors & latency).

it-bot: To request access, please submit the 'Observability Access' form: https://redwood.atlassian.net/servicedesk/obs-access — include email and teams. Note: Grafana view-only is auto-approved; Datadog needs SSO group mapping; Sentry needs project membership.

Priya: hi Jamie — I can add you to the Grafana viewers group right now. Sam, can you do Datadog onboarding when you have a minute? @Sam

Sam: On it. Jamie's email added to the datadog-sre group, you'll get an invite through SSO within 10 mins. For Sentry, please tell me which customer projects you need access to (or 'dev-team' for default dev projects).

Jamie: default dev-team projects only for now. also any recommended dashboards to bookmark? looking for 'infra > latency overview' and 'sentry > recent errors'

Priya: Here's a quick list: Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/latency-overview, Datadog dashboards: https://app.datadoghq.com/dashboard/xyz (latency & errors), Sentry: https://sentry.redwood.com/organizations/redwood/issues/ — I'll DM you saved dashboard links.

onboarding-bot: Onboarding checklist updated: Observability tasks marked complete: Grafana access granted. Datadog pending confirmation. Sentry pending. Track progress: https://redwood/wiki/onboarding/jamie

Jamie: thanks everyone! I filed the service desk ticket just now (REQ-4521). will ping if I don't get invites in 30m.

Sam: Confirmed invite sent. If you hit MFA prompts, choose 'TOTP' and contact @it-ops for YubiKey provisioning.

Jamie: invite received and SSO worked. can access Grafana and Datadog dashboards. Sentry still shows limited access — Sam, do you need ticket number?

Sam: No ticket needed, I just added you to the 'dev-team' org on Sentry. Try again in 5 mins and tell me if you see the project list.

Jamie: All good now — can see Sentry projects and the error stream. Closing loop. really appreciate the quick help :smile:
